'''Ryan Andes''' is an American voice actor for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Andes was born on December 15, 1978, in Los Angeles County, California, but was raised in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. As an adult, he became an actor in 2010, and initially starred in minor roles in short films and TV shows. In 2013, he became a voice actor and worked on the English-language versions of international shows. Andes began working for the English dub of {{aniseries|PTS}} during {{aniseries|SM}}, voicing [[island kahuna]] [[Hala]]. Andes currently resides in New York City, New York. Andes is currently affiliated with A3 Artists Agency.
